events.verdict: Eason (HOU) makes illegal contact with DeRozan's (SAC) arm during his jump shot attempt.
Sabonis (SAC) extends both hands into Sengun (HOU), initiating illegal contact to his body before Monk (SAC) makes contact with the ball.
Sengun (HOU) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Fox's (SAC) driving shot attempt.
Thompson (HOU) makes clean contact with the ball during DeRozan's (SAC) jump shot attempt.
The ball is last touched by Thompson (HOU) before going out of bounds.
Brooks (HOU) legally contests DeRozan's (SAC) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released. DeRozan extends his leg slightly and the ensuing contact with Brooks is marginal.

Replay review of the foul called on Brooks (HOU) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Brooks initiates contact with Fox's (SAC) left arm that causes him to lose control of the ball.
Murray (SAC) makes marginal contact with Green's (HOU) right arm prior to release of his driving shot attempt.
Lyles (SAC) gathers the pass on his left foot and takes two steps before releasing the pass.

Brooks (HOU) grabs and pulls Fox's (SAC) jersey away from his body, which affects his ability to move freely. After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that the foul occurred prior to the release of the throw-in and is therefore an away-from-the-play foul.
Eason (HOU) commits a take foul on Fox (SAC).
Brooks (HOU) reaches in and makes illegal contact to Monk's (SAC) leg.
Murray (SAC) contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with Green's (HOU) arms.
Lyles (SAC) and Sengun (HOU) pursue the rebound and marginal arm to arm contact occurs.
Eason (HOU) makes more than marginal contact with DeRozan's (SAC) right arm as he reaches for the ball.
